facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends a source audience of at least 1,000 matched active users for Audience Lookalike Expansion, and says a larger seed audience is better.
facts.quote: The recommended source audience size is at least 1,000 matched active users, and the more people in the seed audience, the better.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that pixel-based Lookalike Audiences need an average of 4,000 pixel fires before a lookalike can begin to be built.
facts.quote: They are pixel based, meaning you need to wait for an average of 4,000 pixel fires before a lookalike can begin to be built.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that Audience Lookalike Expansion can be used with 1,000 unique users and requires no advance pixel implementation.
facts.quote: it can be leveraged as long as there are 1,000 unique users—no advance pixel implementation required.

facts.fact: StackAdapt claims Audience Lookalike Expansion can increase advertisers' conversions up to 2x (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Not only can Audience Lookalike Expansion help with scale and reach, but it can also increase your conversions up to 2x.

facts.fact: In one StackAdapt conversion campaign, Audience Lookalike Expansion increased conversions by 1.5x, where 40% of conversions had come from users in the CRM list (vendor case study).
facts.quote: In one StackAdapt conversion campaign, where 40% of the conversions came from users within the CRM list, Audience Lookalike Expansion increased their conversions by 1.5x.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes Audience Lookalike Expansion as finding users who mimic the online behaviour of users targeted through StackAdapt Custom Segments or 1st-party data.
facts.quote: Audience Lookalike Expansion allows you to extend your audience reach by finding users who mimic the online behaviour of those you’ve targeted through your StackAdapt Custom Segments or 1st-party data

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that Lookalike Audiences use visitors who viewed a page as the seed audience for ad targeting.
facts.quote: Lookalike Audiences use visitors that viewed a page as the seed audience for ad targeting.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says advertisers wanting only net-new audiences can upload a CRM list as a negative segment and enable Audience Lookalike Expansion.
facts.quote: Advertisers who want to reach only net-new audiences can upload their CRM list as a negative segment and turn on Audience Lookalike Expansion.

facts.fact: The article was published on September 16, 2020.
